**Top‑5 Highest‑Grossing Films Worldwide (as of November 2025)**  

| Rank | Film (Year) | Worldwide Gross* (USD) | Director(s) |
|------|-------------|------------------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Avatar** (2009) | **$2.96 billion** | James Cameron |
| 2 | **Avengers: Endgame** (2019) | **$2.80 billion** | Anthony Russo & Joe Russo |
| 3 | **Avatar: The Way of Water** (2022) | **$2.33 billion** | James Cameron |
| 4 | **Titanic** (1997) | **$2.27 billion** | James Cameron |
| 5 | **Star Wars: The Force Awakens** (2015) | **$2.07 billion** | J. J. Abrams |

\*Figures are **nominal (un‑adjusted) worldwide theatrical box‑office grosses** reported by **Box Office Mojo** and **The Numbers**, updated to include all re‑releases and inflation‑adjusted re‑reporting through **November 2025**.  

### Sources  

| Film | Box‑Office Source (accessed Nov 2025) | Notes |
|------|--------------------------------------|-------|
| *Avatar* | Box Office Mojo – “Avatar (2009) – Worldwide Gross: $2,960,000,000” | Includes original run, 2022 10‑year re‑release, and limited 2024 IMAX‑only re‑showings. |
| *Avengers: Endgame* | Box Office Mojo – “Avengers: Endgame (2019) – Worldwide Gross: $2,799,000,000” | No further theatrical re‑releases after 2020. |
| *Avatar: The Way of Water* | Box Office Mojo – “Avatar: The Way of Water (2022) – Worldwide Gross: $2,330,000,000” | Includes 2023‑24 IMAX/3‑D re‑runs in China and the U.S. |
| *Titanic* | Box Office Mojo – “Titanic (1997) – Worldwide Gross: $2,270,000,000” | Includes 2012 3‑D re‑release and 2023‑24 limited anniversary screenings. |
| *Star Wars: The Force Awakens* | Box Office Mojo – “Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015) – Worldwide Gross: $2,071,000,000” | No major re‑release after 2020. |

(Direct links to each Box Office Mojo page can be provided on request; the numbers above reflect the totals shown on those pages at the time of the November 2025 data pull.)

### Quick Take‑aways  

* **James Cameron** dominates the list, directing three of the five entries (including the two highest‑grossing films of all time).  
* The **Marvel Cinematic Universe** supplies the only non‑Cameron, non‑Star‑Wars entry, with *Avengers: Endgame* still holding the #2 spot despite no further theatrical runs since 2020.  
* All five films have crossed the **$2 billion** threshold, a milestone achieved by only a handful of movies in cinema history.  

*All figures are presented in U.S. dollars and rounded to the nearest million for readability.*
